title: Act: Remove execution wiring and routes from server.New
summary: Drop the execution import, store, handler and routes from server.go.
description: Edit backend/internal/server/server.go so it no longer references the execution package and mounts only round admin routes.
acceptance_criteria: Given server.go, when read, then it has no execution import, exStore, eh or /executions routes.
Given New, when mounting admin routes, then it iterates adminRoundRoutes(rh).
technical_constraints: gitCLI is still used by contribution.FileStore, so keep it

steps.action: Delete the exStore := &execution.FileStore{...} literal and the eh := &execution.Handler{Service: exStore} line.
steps.expected: New has no exStore or eh variables.

steps.action: Change the loop to range adminRoundRoutes(rh) instead of adminRoutes(eh, rh).
steps.code: for _, rt := range adminRoutes(eh, rh) -> for _, rt := range adminRoundRoutes(rh)
steps.expected: Admin group mounts only the five round routes.

steps.action: Delete the whole adminRoutes function and its doc comment, which only existed to prepend the /executions routes.
steps.expected: adminRoutes no longer exists; go build ./... succeeds.
